deviations.description: Missing-structure requests (rule D) with PTV volume around 209-220 cc and little or no mandible inside the PTV are sent to planning. Layer-1 units 7 and 10, which normally push toward escalation, are switched off by their negative missing weights until the PTV exceeds about 215 cc. Just below that, the PTV-volume-driven plan units (2, 3, 10) outweigh the missing-structure signal from unit 3, regardless of cov, cap, mand_lim or the cord values.
deviations.condition: (missing == 1) and (209 <= ptv_vol <= 220) and (mand_in_ptv < 3) and (cov < cap) and (cord_floor < cord_lim)
